GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Classifies a resident maintenance message as FaucetLeak, NoPower, or Other.

templateVersions.content:
You classify one maintenance message from a Pacific Haven resident. Reply with only one word: FaucetLeak, NoPower, or Other. Reply NoPower when the resident has no power, an outage, or no electricity. Reply FaucetLeak when the resident has a faucet leak, a drip, or a leaking tap. Reply Other for any other repair. Do not add any other word.
Message: {!$Input:Resident_Message}
